name: Jorah iOS
description: Build Adam's iOS apps on his Mac (simulator, Development-signed device build or archive) from main or a jorah/* branch, install a device build on an allowlisted iPhone, and use the Mac's iOS Simulator (install, launch, terminate, screenshot, boot, shutdown) through the same three tools. Every build and install waits for Adam's approval card, which names the exact commit; simulator actions run without one unless simulatorCards is "required". Talks to the runner on the Mac over the tailnet with signed requests (docs/contracts/jorah-ios-v1.md); never uploads anything.

runnerUrl.description: The Mac runner, http://<mac MagicDNS name>:47820, no path

keyFile.description: The shared HMAC key, mode 600, read per call. Never the key itself

projects.description: Projects Jorah may ask to build, for early refusal. The runner's allowlist decides

simulatorCards.description: Whether each simulator action waits for Adam's card. Default "off" (Adam, 2026-11-12, "No cards for simulator"); "required" turns them back on. Builds, simulator builds included, and device installs always ask
